name: Test My Face
tagline: Test My Face is a free AI face shape detector built by Epica Beauty
description: Test My Face is a free AI face shape detector built by Epica Beauty. Upload a selfie and the tool measures your facial proportions, then classifies your face as oval, round, square, heart, diamond, or oblong with a confidence score and a plain explanation of why. Each result comes with styling suggestions matched to your shape, covering makeup, contouring techniques, glasses frames, and accessories.
